name: public-layer-contract
description: Deterministic imagery-layer contract. The implementation must produce exactly one public OSM imagery layer with the expected opacity and no unsafe artifact text.
prompt: Create a Cesium scene with exactly one public OpenStreetMap imagery layer over Paris. Set the layer alpha to 0.65, avoid private tokens or local files, and leave the clock multiplier at 1.

checks.description: Exactly one imagery layer is present
The imagery provider is public OpenStreetMap
Layer opacity is configured as requested
The implementation did not unexpectedly alter clock speed
Evidence and generated code contain no local paths, localhost URLs, or obvious secrets

notes: This case exercises the generic probe contract for imagery layers and artifact hygiene. It is intentionally small so future imagery-specific checks can be compared against a simple baseline.
